title: Soul Night Market – Mornington
summary: Evening street-food and makers market at the Peninsula Community Theatre precinct: local food vendors, artisan makers, live music, runs from 5pm.
recurrenceNote: Selected dates only – not monthly regular
nearbyAttractions: Mornington foreshore; Main Street Mornington dining
suggestedItineraryPairing: Evening market + foreshore walk + Mornington dining
editorVerdict: Night markets done the Peninsula way: low-key, food-led, and over by the time you'd order a second round in the city.
editorNote:
Soul Night Market Mornington takes over the Peninsula Community Theatre precinct on selected evenings, with local food trucks, makers and live music from 5pm. It's the night-market formula in a small-town key, you'll be home in bed at a sensible hour.

Go for dinner, not for shopping. Pick two food vans, eat as you wander, then walk down to the foreshore for the post-dinner stretch.

Dates are irregular and not always listed on the council page; the organiser's socials are the real source of truth.
kidsGradeNote: Family-friendly enough, but evening timing and crowds around food vans suit older kids better than toddlers.
